Ok.

I have permanently banned dylan for flyhacking, thanks for taking the time to gather proof and report online, it's really appreciated.

However, I can't find Pelpelajax (now known as PelThePenguin) thread saying that ToggleSprint was legal (could you link it?) but I can clearly see in the rules it being disallowed as per C.3.10 :




Thanks a lot for being honest though, I will look into it and get back to you quoting this post, even if it's already locked. Again thanks for trying to help keep the network clean by reporting, keep the good work up!

My kindest regards,

javipepe - Avicus Developer, Mod and Advisor
